selectedIdea.angle: Show what the evidence says about census.

synthesis.factHandoff: The 2020 US resident population was about 331.45 million, up 22.7 million (7.4% relative to 2010). The population count refers to April 1, not the announcement date.

narrative.content:
Kern van het verhaal
De bevolking groeide over het decennium met 7,4 procent.

Redactionele insteek
Licht dit feit in gewone taal toe.
